The enterprise AI challenge

AI Adoption Requires More Than a Successful Prototype.

A useful experiment is a starting point. Enterprise adoption needs clear investment decisions, secure foundations and an operating model.

Investment priorities

Choose opportunities with a clear business case and measurable expected value.

Connected enterprise systems

Address fragmented data and applications before scaling an isolated solution.

Security and governance

Establish access controls, data protection and clear decision responsibilities.

Production readiness

Plan integration, reliability and ownership beyond a successful demonstration.

Costs and outcomes

Understand operating costs and agree how business progress will be measured.

Enterprise AI Transformation Blueprint

Why NEWRONIQ?

Enterprise Architecture Meets Cloud Security.

Independent technical judgement informed by enterprise architecture, software engineering, cloud infrastructure and security. We make trade-offs explicit and connect recommendations to the people who will operate the solution.

Enterprise architecture and integration

Connect AI capabilities to enterprise APIs, data ownership and business workflows. Define clear boundaries across distributed systems.

AWS and Azure architecture

Evaluate Amazon Bedrock and Microsoft Foundry in the context of existing cloud investments, identity, data access and operating costs.

Secure AI applications

Assess RAG and AI agents against permission boundaries, retrieval quality, tool controls and human approval needs.

Production reliability

Design cloud infrastructure security, observability, recovery and operational ownership into the architecture. Balance resilience and scalability with cost.
